payload.summary: Implemented the strict v2 semantic-query path over immutable RI02 indexes. The reader now proves exact revision, canonical index identity, provider compatibility, principal-bound scope, runtime readiness, and transport parity before returning provenance-bearing hits; every non-ready state requires exact-search fallback.
completed_work: Added exact immutable storage selection and bounded cosine KNN.
Added principal/work-package authorization and typed fail-closed states.
Added loop-owned HTTP/direct-MCP runtimes, proxy parity, and truthful capability discovery.
Added 478 passing deterministic tests plus six explicitly resource-deferred RI03 Postgres cases.

decisions.title: Fail closed before embedding
decisions.rationale: Revision, index, provider, and scope authority are validated before any semantic provider or storage work.

decisions.title: Publish body-aware dynamic capability
decisions.rationale: CAN_CODE_SEARCH is true only when a ready provider and compatible canonical v2 storage are currently usable.

next_steps: Complete independent implementation reviews and validation artifacts.
Run live Postgres/provider/retrieval-quality gates before production enablement.
